name: node_degree
author: EE23B022
description: Calculates how many edges touch a node. Use it to answer node connection and degree questions. For an undirected graph it returns the node id, label, and degree. For a directed graph it returns the node id, label, outgoing degree, incoming degree, and total degree.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to analyse.

node.description: The node id whose connections should be counted. Use lookup_node to find the id.
